subject: Invoice cleanup & credit path for OptiMed Analytics — duplicate ingestion lines & VAT handling
messages:
From: Helena Costa <helena@optimed.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@optimed.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected duplicate usage lines on Mar invoice — request for correction

Hi Vanessa,

We just reviewed our March invoice (INV-2027-03) and flagged duplicate ingestion line items that doubled our metered charges for the "clinical-ingest" connector on 2027-03-14. The attached CSV (optimed-usage-202703.csv) shows two identical batches recorded twice in your export.

Can Redwood issue a corrective invoice or a credit memo? We also need VAT documentation that shows how the credit will be processed — we are registered for VAT in Ireland (IE1234567) and need the right paperwork to reconcile our books.

Total disputed amount on our side: EUR 18,450 (incl. 23% VAT). Please advise next steps and expected timelines — this is blocking our month-end close.

Thanks,
Helena Costa
Head of Finance
OptiMed Analytics

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Helena Costa <helena@optimed.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicate usage lines on Mar invoice — request for correction

Hi Helena — thanks for the flag and the CSV attachment. I've looped in Ben (AM) and Marcus (Revenue Ops) to investigate.

Quick plan:
- Marcus to run a reconciliation against the raw ingestion logs and confirm whether it was duplicated in our processing pipeline or a downstream billing aggregation error.
- If confirmed duplicate, Redwood will issue a credit memo and an updated invoice.
- We will include VAT reversal paperwork (EU VAT credit note) suitable for Irish bookkeeping and copy you on the signed credit memo.

Ben, Marcus — can you confirm ETA on the reconciliation? We know month-end is tight for OptiMed.

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Unexpected duplicate usage lines on Mar invoice — request for correction

Vanessa / Ben — I ran an initial reconciliation against ingestion logs and billing aggregation. Summary: two ingestion batches (2027-03-14T02:11Z and 2027-03-14T02:12Z) were processed twice due to a replay on the consumer queue during a short-lived connector restart. That caused duplicate token accounting for the clinical-ingest connector for OptiMed.

Numbers: duplicated token total = 62,500 tokens; pre-VAT amount = EUR 14,985. VAT at 23% = EUR 3,445.55; gross disputed = EUR 18,430.55 (rounding differences aside).

Action items I recommend:
1) Issue a signed credit memo for EUR 18,430.55 referencing INV-2027-03 and ticket #OPTM-045.
2) Re-issue an adjusted invoice (INV-2027-03A) showing net correction and cross-reference the credit memo.
3) Provide OptiMed with an exportable VAT credit note and a short explanation letter they can attach to their VAT return.
4) Finance to hold any collection activity while we process the credit.

I'll prepare the credit memo draft and mark it for legal sign-off. ETA: credit memo PDF + updated invoice for internal review by Tue 2027-04-27 EOD (CEST).

Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 13:02:00 +0200
Subject: RE: Unexpected duplicate usage lines on Mar invoice — request for correction

Thanks Marcus — reviewed the draft credit memo. Legal is fine with the wording and the reference to INV-2027-03 and ticket OPTM-045. A couple of small points:
- Add a line clarifying this is a billing correction due to a processing replay; not a service performance credit (avoids SLA semantics).
- Include a single-point contact in Redwood for VAT follow-ups (suggest: Marcus Lin).

Marcus — once you attach the signed credit memo we should also prepare a brief cover note for OptiMed explaining how this will appear on their SAP/QuickBooks (two-line explanation + reference docs).

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Helena Costa <helena@optimed.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Updated invoice & signed credit memo issued (INV-2027-03A / credit memo)

Hi Helena — thanks for your patience. Attached: signed-credit-memo-OPTM-045.pdf and the adjusted invoice (INV-2027-03A, attached as invoice_202703_OptiMed.pdf).

Summary of outcome:
- Credit memo issued for EUR 18,430.55 (includes 23% VAT).
- Adjusted invoice INV-2027-03A reflects the corrected usage lines; outstanding balance reduced accordingly.
- We will not take any collection action related to the disputed lines.
- Marcus will be your VAT contact for any follow-up documentation required by Irish tax authorities.

Next steps for OptiMed:
1) Confirm receipt and whether the attached PDF credit memo + brief cover note are sufficient for your VAT filings.
2) If you need a supplier statement or additional evidence (e.g., raw ingestion log extract), we can provide a sanitized CSV.

Helena, please reply to confirm and we'll mark the ticket closed from our side. Appreciate the quick coordination — Ben and I will follow up with the AM healthcheck next month to ensure the connector restart doesn't recur.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments (referenced): signed-credit-memo-OPTM-045.pdf (signed credit memo, 1 page), invoice_202703_OptiMed.pdf (adjusted invoice, 2 pages)
